descriptionHtml:
LED Autolamps load resistors are designed for late-model vehicles that display a light-failure warning. Each resistor draws the same current as a 21 watt globe.

How to install LED Autolamps load resistors

  • Mount on a metal surface: the resistor can reach temperatures of up to 170°C.
  • You may require up to 1 resistor per function on each side.
  • Always wire the resistor between the input wires of the lamp, not to the chassis of the vehicle or trailer. If fitted to the chassis, a bad earth connection is possible and can cause problems with the vehicle's lighting system.

Available as LR12/2 (twin blister, 50 watt, 6Ω) for 12V vehicles and LR24/2 (twin blister, 50 watt, 24Ω) for 24V vehicles.
